target.title: fix(media-core): detect MIME from encoded URL extensions
target.body:
Fixes encoded HTTP(S) media URLs such as `render%2Emp4` being treated as unknown by the media-core MIME fallback.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users or plugins that pass media URLs with percent-encoded filename extensions could get an unknown MIME result when the URL still points to a supported file type.

For example, a normal URL such as:

```text
https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4?download=1
```

is classified as `video/mp4`, but the encoded filename equivalent:

```text
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1
```

misses the `.mp4` extension on current `main` because the URL pathname remains percent-encoded before `path.extname()` runs. That affects the shared `mimeTypeFromFilePath()` / `detectMime({ filePath })` fallback used by media callers when no stronger MIME signal is available.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix keeps the behavior scoped to HTTP(S) URL filename extension lookup in `getFileExtension()`. It extracts the final URL pathname segment first, decodes only that filename segment before extracting the extension, and falls back to the original filename segment if that segment contains malformed percent encoding.

This does not add a shared filename decoder, does not parse `Content-Disposition`, does not change local path fallback behavior, and does not let encoded path separators after an extension turn a non-filename suffix into a media extension. It only makes encoded URL filenames follow the same MIME classification path as the equivalent decoded filename.

## User Impact

Media URLs whose filename encodes the extension dot can now be classified like their ordinary URL equivalents.

Examples that now flow through the expected media MIME fallback:

```text
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1 -> video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Em%70%34         -> video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2EMP4            -> video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/clip%2Ewebm             -> video/webm
```

That helps downstream media handling choose the correct behavior when a CDN or provider returns encoded URL filename components.

## Evidence

Behavior proof from current `main` before this change:

```text
https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4?download=1   -> video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1 -> undefined
https://cdn.example.com/clip%2Ewebm             -> undefined
```

After-fix terminal proof from the PR branch using the actual media-core helpers:

```text
https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4?download=1 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2Em%70%34 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render%2EMP4 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/clip%2Ewebm -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/webm; detectMime=video/webm
https://cdn.example.com/bad%ZZ/render%2Emp4 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/archive%2Fclip.mp4 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/archive%2Fclip%2Emp4 -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=video/mp4; detectMime=video/mp4
https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4%2Fpreview -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=undefined; detectMime=undefined
https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4%5Cpreview -> mimeTypeFromFilePath=undefined; detectMime=undefined
```

Focused coverage now exercises the shared media-core fallback and the edge cases called out by the URL filename-decoding review:

```text
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1") === "video/mp4"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/render%2Em%70%34") === "video/mp4"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/render%2EMP4") === "video/mp4"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/clip%2Ewebm") === "video/webm"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/bad%ZZ/render%2Emp4") === "video/mp4"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/archive%2Fclip%2Emp4") === "video/mp4"
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4%2Fpreview") === undefined
mimeTypeFromFilePath("https://cdn.example.com/render.mp4%5Cpreview") === undefined
detectMime({ filePath: "https://cdn.example.com/render%2Emp4?download=1" }) === "video/mp4"
```

Validation:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run packages/media-core/src/mime.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       111 passed (111)

git diff --check
passed
```
